description:
Powerful Performance. Long-Range Freedom. Built for Adventure.
The LIKEBIKE U15 Electric Bike is built for riders looking for powerful performance, long-range capability, and all-terrain versatility. Featuring a 2000W peak motor, a large 48V 20Ah removable battery, and rugged 20" × 4.0" fat tires, the U15 is ready for daily commuting, weekend adventures, and challenging terrain.
With a top speed of up to 34 MPH, up to 95 N·m of torque, and climbing capability of up to 35°, the U15 delivers strong acceleration and confident performance on hills and uneven roads.
The removable 48V 20Ah battery provides an estimated 60–80 miles of range in pedal-assist mode, making longer rides easier with fewer charging stops. The integrated BMS protection system helps manage battery performance and safety, while the removable design allows convenient indoor charging.
A full suspension system with front and rear shock absorption helps reduce vibration and impact on rough terrain. Combined with wide 20" × 4.0" fat tires, the U15 delivers enhanced traction and stability on city streets, mountain roads, sand, snow, and other riding surfaces.
The integrated LCD display with NFC unlock provides quick access to key riding information, including speed, mileage, riding mode, and battery level.
Choose from three riding modes:

Pure Electric Mode – Ride using motor power without pedaling.

Pedal Assist Mode – Motor assistance makes pedaling easier and helps extend riding range.

Regular Cycling Mode – Ride like a conventional bicycle for exercise or casual cycling.
